title: eat shit & die 245
author: bpatrick
body:
I’m not dead yet.

Being in exile, this happens to be the first comic I did completely on the tablet. That’s why the drawing looks so shitty. (Yeah, that’s why).

comments.author: Jank Hambrams
comments.text: Haha, “shitty.” This looks great dude! Great lighting, too.

comments.author: SamShamTheSandMan
comments.text:
I like the way it looks? Like the smugness made me think it was the womans dream or blurry vision of the monsters chasing her?

I’m glad to see you posted you’re my favorite webcomic. 🙂

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text:
Thanks, guys!
The coloring is ok, but the drawings and the line work are lousy because I’m not used to doing them on the computer.
@Freezeflare: I just meant away from desk and art supplies (and family, incidentally but not inconsequentially). I had to do my last two months of medical school away from home.
